sources.title: Python math.isqrt documentation
sources.enterprise_use: Adopts the greatest-integer inequality characterization of integer square root; Enterprise Math does not require the hidden-real floor interpretation as primitive.
sources.not_claimed: Integer square root itself is not novel.

sources.title: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.NthRootLemmas
sources.enterprise_use: Reuses Mathlib Nat.nthRoot and its order-theoretic characterization, exact perfect-power recovery, and supporting nth-root lemmas as the formal primitive for Enterprise Math integer roots.
sources.not_claimed: Natural-number nth roots, their formal implementation, and their order characterization are established mathlib work, not Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Floor.Div
sources.enterprise_use: Uses the order-theoretic view of flooring division as a right adjoint: the greatest integer state satisfying an inequality.
sources.not_claimed: Floor/ceiling division and its Galois-adjoint formulation are established mathematics.

sources.title: Mathlib.Order.Closure
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the established language of monotone, idempotent closure/interior-style operators and their connection with Galois adjoints.
sources.not_claimed: Closure/interior operators and Galois connections are not novel.

sources.title: Integer Representation of Decimal Numbers for Exact Computations
sources.enterprise_use: Shows exact additions, subtractions and multiplications after representing decimal inputs by integers at a prescribed scale.
sources.not_claimed: Scaled-integer arithmetic is not novel; Enterprise Math changes the foundational interpretation.

sources.title: Multigrid Methods Using Block Floating Point Arithmetic
sources.enterprise_use: Provides modern scaled-fixed-point/block-floating examples where integer matrix/vector operations can be exact up to specified precision.
sources.not_claimed: Integer-plus-scale numerical formats are not novel.

sources.title: Implementing exact real arithmetic in python, C++ and C
sources.enterprise_use: Demonstrates scaled-integer exact-real computation; used as a contrast because it retains exact real numbers as the target semantics.
sources.not_claimed: Scaled-integer exact-real arithmetic is not Enterprise Math's invention.

sources.title: FLINT qqbar: algebraic numbers represented by minimal polynomials
sources.enterprise_use: Shows that algebraic numbers can be represented exactly by finite integer polynomial data plus an isolating interval.
sources.not_claimed: Finite exact symbolic representation of algebraic numbers is established; Enterprise Math questions the hidden real-number ontology rather than representation alone.

sources.title: Sage elements optimized for quadratic number fields
sources.enterprise_use: Shows exact quadratic-field elements represented internally by integer triples.
sources.not_claimed: Integer encodings of algebraic extensions are established mathematics/software.

sources.title: Indeterminism in Physics, Classical Chaos and Bohmian Mechanics. Are Real Numbers Really Real?
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a prior physical argument that infinite-information real numbers should not automatically be treated as physically real and proposes finite-information numbers.
sources.not_claimed: The critique of physically instantiated infinite-precision reals is prior work.

sources.title: Physics without Determinism: Alternative Interpretations of Classical Physics
sources.enterprise_use: Names the principle of infinite precision and develops finite-information quantities as an alternative classical interpretation.
sources.not_claimed: Finite-information critiques of classical real-number ontology are prior work.

sources.title: Quantized Space-Time
sources.enterprise_use: Provides an early explicit example of Lorentz-invariant discrete spacetime.
sources.not_claimed: Discrete spacetime is not novel to Enterprise Math.

sources.title: Space-time as a causal set
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a locally finite partially ordered spacetime model and a continuum-approximation direction.
sources.not_claimed: Local finiteness, causal-set order, and discrete spacetime are established prior ideas.

sources.title: Irreversibility and Heat Generation in the Computing Process
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the classic link between logical functions lacking a single-valued inverse and physical dissipation.
sources.not_claimed: Logical irreversibility and its thermodynamic study are prior work; Enterprise Math does not treat its ontological collapse as ordinary information erasure by default.

sources.title: Logical Reversibility of Computation
sources.enterprise_use: Shows how computation can preserve intermediate history and be made logically reversible.
sources.not_claimed: Reversible computation is prior work; Enterprise Math tests whether nature itself need not preserve a reversible completion.

sources.title: Memory Effects in Irreversible Thermodynamics
sources.enterprise_use: Provides an exact projection-based route to irreversible macroscopic equations with memory effects.
sources.not_claimed: Projection-based derivation of macro-irreversibility from finer dynamics is prior work and is a major contrast class.

sources.title: Transport, Collective Motion, and Brownian Motion
sources.enterprise_use: Develops projection/operator methods for macroscopic stochastic and transport descriptions.
sources.not_claimed: Mori-Zwanzig projection methods are established; Enterprise Math tests a stronger fundamentally many-to-one ontology.

sources.title: Preimage entropy for mappings
sources.enterprise_use: Part of the established program quantifying non-invertibility through preimage structure.
sources.not_claimed: Preimage entropy is not novel.

sources.title: Pre-image entropy
sources.enterprise_use: Defines preimage entropy invariants intended to quantify how far a map is from invertibility.
sources.not_claimed: Entropy based on preimage structure is established prior work.

sources.title: Positivity of entropy production in nonequilibrium statistical mechanics
sources.enterprise_use: Introduces folding-entropy ideas in the study of entropy production for non-invertible dynamics.
sources.not_claimed: Folding entropy and its relation to entropy production are prior work.

sources.title: On preimage entropy, folding entropy and stable entropy
sources.enterprise_use: Explicitly studies how non-invertibility contributes to entropy and relates preimage entropy to folding entropy under stated conditions.
sources.not_claimed: The connection between preimages, non-invertibility and entropy has an established literature.

sources.title: Completely positive dynamical semigroups of N-level systems
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a canonical physical use of forward dynamical semigroups in Markovian open quantum evolution.
sources.not_claimed: Forward semigroup descriptions in physics are established; this formalism is not Enterprise Math's model.

sources.title: On the generators of quantum dynamical semigroups
sources.enterprise_use: Provides another canonical mathematical characterization of forward quantum dynamical semigroups.
sources.not_claimed: Semigroup time evolution in open quantum systems is prior work and does not establish fundamental ontological collapse.

sources.title: On the Foundations of Combinatorial Theory I. Theory of Möbius Functions
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the established incidence-algebra and Möbius-inversion framework underlying divisor-lattice sign transforms used in the P017 parity calculation.
sources.not_claimed: Möbius inversion on locally finite posets, including divisor lattices, is established prior mathematics; Enterprise Math does not claim it as novel.

sources.title: Almost-Primes Between Consecutive Squares
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a current rigorous benchmark for sieve methods on intervals between consecutive squares: every such interval contains an integer with at most three prime factors, with explicit discussion of the weighted-sieve limitations relevant to P017.
sources.not_claimed: Sieve-theoretic work on square intervals and the stated P3 result are prior work; P017 does not claim them as Enterprise Math discoveries.

sources.title: An Algorithm and Estimates for the Legendre, Oppermann, and Brocard Prime-Counting Functions
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a finite computational benchmark: Oppermann's conjecture, and hence Legendre's conjecture, is verified through n = 7.05e13; used to separate finite validation from proof in P017.
sources.not_claimed: Large-scale computational verification of Legendre/Oppermann ranges is prior work and is not an Enterprise Math proof.

sources.title: Dynamic Sieve Systems
sources.enterprise_use: Provides an independent dynamical-systems formulation of Eratosthenes sieve and quadratic-density models for intervals between consecutive squares; used as a close conceptual neighbor for P017's square-basin sieve dynamics.
sources.not_claimed: Dynamic reinterpretation of the sieve and quadratic-density heuristic models are prior work; P017's exact basin identities must be distinguished from them.
